templates.why_chosen: A numbered three-step path crosses an IPC/LFC trust boundary from the in-process PhOS frontend to a separate PhOS backend, which plugs into any of four labelled checkpoint-image sources (Memory/SSD/RDMA/NVM).
templates.what_to_learn: Cross a trust boundary (here IPC/LFC) between an in-process frontend and a separate backend with one numbered arrow, and show a pluggable backend by listing its interchangeable sources (Memory/SSD/RDMA/NVM) in one small box rather than drawing each as a separate tier.
